title: Fractera Design — the shared look of your products in one place
description: The design of your project — colours of the light and dark theme, fonts, text scale, corners, spacing and block settings — in one place. Save once, and every service that follows it re-renders its pages in seconds.

blocks.title: One look for every product of your project
blocks.description: Colours for the light and dark theme, fonts, text scale, corners and spacing live in one place. Save once, and every service that follows the design re-renders its pages in seconds, still static.

blocks.text: On this element’s pages: the colours of both themes, the fonts, text and spacing, the blocks.
One set for the whole project, the light and the dark theme side by side.
Every subscribed service gets it the moment you save and takes the new design over MCP.
Each service re-renders its pages in seconds, still static; visitors see it after reloading.
Only the architect changes the design, after signing in; services read it with the node’s key.
This element starts with the node. The node holds the switch: the architect turns it off or on with a word to the main agent, or on the element's settings page in the core.

blocks.text: This is a working project, not only a landing: the colours of both themes, the fonts, the text scale, corners and spacing change on this element's pages, and every service that follows the design redraws its pages within seconds.
Why: one look for every element of the project, with no theme files scattered across repositories. Who: only the architect, after signing in.

Every service of the project that subscribes to it: the site, sign-in, data, blocks, project settings and this element itself. A service without the Design element keeps its own theme and runs as before.
The design skill of the project is chosen here too.

blocks.title: Your own builder comes with it

blocks.text: Every element of the node comes with its own Claude Code agent and can get its own Telegram bot. When something in this element should change, write to its bot from your phone, and the agent updates the logic or the design.
The agent works only in its element's folder and never reads the whole node, so each change costs fewer tokens. Your Claude Code subscription pays for it.

items: The element's bot is connected in the core, on its «Telegram» page.
The agent returns a commit; you look at it in «Preview» and accept it or turn it down.
At the computer, the agent's terminal is in the core, in this element's «Build».

blocks.text: Built by Fractera for the [Lagrix](https://lagrix.dev) protocol and for any web2 project with more than one product. MIT license, the code is at [github.com/Fractera/fractera-design-starter](https://github.com/Fractera/fractera-design-starter).

items.q: Do the pages have to be rebuilt after a change?
items.a: No. Each service redraws its pages within seconds and they stay static; visitors see the change after a reload.
Any font from Google Fonts, in three roles: headings, text and code.

items.q: What if a service does not follow the design?
items.a: It keeps its own theme and works as before.
